title: Somali National Army Participates in Multinational Military Exercise in Turkey
detail: The Somali National Army joined a multinational military exercise hosted by Turkey, signaling a deepening Somalia-Turkey defense partnership. The exercise reflects growing bilateral military cooperation as Somalia continues its domestic counterinsurgency campaign against al-Shabaab. Turkey has emerged as a key defense partner for Somalia, providing training, equipment, and operational support.
